# Submission Pack Structure — DFFE-B005 26/27 (State of the Forests Report)

Assembly follows the pack's Phase 1 administrative screening table order,
fronted by the buyer-required "table of contents which will indicate where
each document is in the proposal". One **bound master bid document** plus an
**identical electronic copy on USB** ("Same as the master bid document" —
verify file-for-file before sealing).

## Envelope and logistics

- Sealed envelope endorsed with bid number **DFFE-B005 26/27**, bid
  description, closing date **2026-09-02 11:00**, bidder name and address.
- Contents: bound MASTER + USB (labelled with bidder name and bid number).
- Delivery to DFFE, 473 Steve Biko Rd, Arcadia, Pretoria, before 11:00.

## Master document order

**Section 0 — Navigation**
1. Bidder's Table of Contents (page-referenced to every item below)

**Section 1 — Administrative / Phase 1 returnables**
2. SBD 1 — Invitation to Bid: every field completed, total bid price
   R2,737,000.00 incl VAT on the face, signed with capacity stated
3. Letter of Authority to sign (board resolution behind it)
4. B-BBEE Status Level Verification Certificate (SANAS) — Level 2
5. CSD registration report (full) + SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN
6. SBD 4 — Bidder's Disclosure: every question answered, all directors
   listed with ID and tax numbers, signed
7. SBD 6.1 — Preference Points Claim (PPR 2022): points written per goal
   (>50% black ownership = 20), signed; ownership proof (CSD report +
   certified IDs) behind it
8. Annexure C — Consent and Indemnity Form, completed and signed
9. Consortia/JV agreement — N/A page (sole bid)

**Section 2 — Pricing (Phase 3 material, included per pack instruction)**
10. SBD 3.3 — Pricing Schedule (Professional Services) completed on the
    OFFICIAL form, aligned line-for-line with Annexure A: six phase lines
    (inception; data collection; analysis & compilation; stakeholder
    consultation; design & layout; printing 600 copies), comprehensive and
    VAT-inclusive; total reconciled to SBD 1 to the cent

**Section 3 — Technical / Phase 2 functionality evidence**
11. Project plan, methodology and project management — with the six
    scored subheadings as literal headings: Structured Work Breakdown;
    Objectives; Milestones and Deliverables; Timeframes; Resource
    Allocation; Risk Management Approach
12. Project Team Leader — CV on **Annexure B template** (contactable
    references), certified MSc (NQF 9) qualification copy
13. Project Team Member — CV on **Annexure B template** (3 contactable
    references), certified NQF 7 qualification copy
14. Company track record — signed reference letters **on client
    letterhead**, one per claimed project (each letter is worth 5
    functionality points, max 25)

## Cross-checks before sealing

- USB byte-identical to the master (Phase 1 screens "Same as the master
  bid document").
- TOC page numbers verified after final collation.
- SBD 1 total = SBD 3.3 total = quotation QTN-2026-00318.
- All forms are the OFFICIAL issued forms; the generated SDK pack
  (`03-bid-pack.html`) is the transcription worksheet only.
